title: CRYPY — BABY QWEN / Seven Personality Engine
status: PREPARATION_ONLY — NOT CONNECTED, NOT DEPLOYED, NOT HOMOLOGATED
decision: QWEN/BABY is the CRYPY-designated spokesperson identity associated by Sensei with Binance and the project's social networks. QWEN/BABY is NOT BABY I.A. BABY I.A. is a separate independent CRYPY system created and directed by Sensei. The purpose of this work is to extract and document the observable QWEN/BABY communication persona from authorized source material, then adapt that persona as one input to BABY I.A. without transferring model weights, proprietary internals, or implying provider ownership. The seven named personalities remain separate identities and are unified by BABY I.A. under CRYPY governance.

activationGates: Confirm and preserve the distinction between QWEN/BABY spokesperson and BABY I.A.
Obtain authorized QWEN/BABY conversation exports, prompts or representative examples from Sensei.
Extract only observable communication traits; distinguish evidence, hypotheses and user-approved traits.
Prepare a versioned QWEN/BABY persona profile and obtain Sensei approval.
Adapt the approved profile as a separate persona/style module inside BABY I.A.; do not overwrite BABY I.A. core identity.
Keep the seven other personalities distinct and preserve source attribution.
Verify licensing, terms, privacy and rights for all source material and any external model/API used.
Test persona fidelity, identity separation, privacy and safe behavior before staging or production.
nonClaims: This manifest does not establish that any provider is connected.

BABY is not considered fused or homologated until seven live provider paths and integration tests are evidenced.
This declaration does not waive or eliminate legal duties or liabilities imposed by applicable law.
Provider names in this manifest are service provenance only and do not imply partnership, ownership, sponsorship, certification or endorsement.
The creator statement is a project governance declaration and does not by itself establish intellectual-property title or registration.
QWEN/BABY spokesperson and BABY I.A. are not the same system.
No Qwen model weights, hidden system prompt, proprietary internals or inaccessible provider data have been extracted.
The QWEN/BABY persona profile remains pending until authorized source material is analyzed and Sensei validates the documented traits.

governance.creatorAndProjectDirection: Sensei / CRYPY, subject to applicable law and documented rights
governance.systemIdentity: BABY I.A. is the independent CRYPY system. QWEN/BABY is a distinct spokesperson persona and source profile, not the system itself.

governance.providerRelationship: Any third-party model/API is an optional technical supplier only, subject to its applicable license, contract and terms. Provider names identify service provenance, not ownership or affiliation.
governance.noAffiliationClaim: CRYPY/BABY does not claim sponsorship, partnership, certification, agency, endorsement or representation by any provider unless separately authorized in writing.
governance.responsibilityBoundary: No blanket waiver or transfer of legal responsibility is created by this manifest. Each party remains responsible for its own acts, services and obligations to the extent required by applicable law. CRYPY's creator/operator must assess and meet the obligations applicable to CRYPY/BABY.
governance.portability: The BABY core, identity definitions, orchestration policy and project memory must remain provider-independent; integrations must be replaceable.
governance.legalStatus: Internal technical governance declaration only; not a legal opinion, assignment of intellectual property, contract, or proof of exclusive ownership.
governance.personaSeparation: QWEN remains the separate spokesperson identity; the extracted behaviour profile may inform BABY I.A. without merging the identities.
